carIdentity.limitation: AC package identity is not proof of period specification

classFamily.limitation: internal FAM/CLS identifiers are not citations

construction.limitation: profile compatibility does not prove a numerical construction model

supplier.limitation: supplier stays unknown without event/car-specific evidence

geometry.basis: imported AC geometry with traceable source
geometry.limitation: sim geometry is not automatically period dimensional evidence

compound.limitation: exact compound properties remain reconstruction unless directly documented

temperature.basis: generator prior; no host-specific live telemetry yet
temperature.limitation: simulator closure is not historical optimum evidence

pressure.basis: reference-duty pressure model only; host remains unvalidated
pressure.limitation: a static software prediction is not a validated live result or automatically a historical racing-pressure source

wearLife.basis: generator family prior; host-specific life unresolved
wearLife.limitation: period durability evidence must not be converted directly into AC virtual-km wear without telemetry calibration

rule: PROFILE COHERENCE checks compatibility only. Historical evidence status reports sourcing separately; internal FAM/CLS IDs are not citations.
